name: always-on-fire-execfail
about: 调度器触发的一轮里 execute 轮次反复给出缺 file_path 的 write_file 调用，轮次以 agent_tool_error_loop 错误结束：run_failed 事件、计划标 failed、写兜底报告（reason execution_failed: …）、state 的 consecutiveFailures、run-history 的 failed 记录，不进入 report 阶段。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
alwaysOn:
  trigger:
    tickIntervalMinutes: 0.05
  projects:
    {HOME}/work/alpha:
      enabled: true
